verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Better Auth serves an llms.txt at its site root and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /docs/introduction.md). The llms.txt also points agents to the right versioned docs. Better Auth additionally documents an AI-resources section with a hosted remote MCP server for documentation search, aimed at agent clients like Cursor and Claude Code. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using llms.txt or the docs in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.better-auth.com/llms.txt # Better Auth
Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).
Use the documentation version that matches the Better Auth version installed in the project.
